clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Bartleby's Mug marks a young warrior's trial of grit. After besting Bartleby in the Pig and Whistle Tavern, you claim his drinking mug for your trainer, Harry Burlguard.

Harry Burlguard tests young warriors with a brawl in Old Town. He asks you to take down Bartleby, a stubborn drunk at the bar of the Pig and Whistle Tavern. Once subdued, Bartleby reluctantly gives up his prized drinking mug, but first takes one final swig to drain the dregs.

Returning the mug to Harry Burlguard completes your novice trial. Burlguard sees that you can persuade through sheer force and recognizes your readiness for defensive mastery. He points you onward to further battlefield instruction with Marshal Haggard, a seasoned veteran in Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ok, here's my mug. Wait! Let me finish what's in it first... There we go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I saw your fight with Bartleby. Nicely done! Did you get his mug?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There it is! He sure didn't want to part with it, but you were persuasive. Well done.
